userStories.title: 缓存大厅保留最新设置
userStories.description: 玩家从牌桌返回历史缓存大厅后，下次开局应保留刚修改的静音、速度及三路音量。
acceptanceCriteria: 在现有真实大厅事件处理器测试中先复现旧偏好重写，再修复；恢复时更新现有偏好/控件，不替换选将、筛选、焦点与滚动状态。
存储不可读或损坏时保留有效内存偏好，不因刷新默认重新打开声音；覆盖存储拒绝、未改变、再次开局载荷。
JS syntax、专项和完整 Node 测试通过；父浏览器静音改设置、Back、再开局验证。真实 BFCache 命中与 pageshow 回归分别记录，不混同。

userStories.title: 原生已提交事件的短反馈
userStories.description: 静音游玩时也能清楚看到谁已出牌或响应，以及真实受击发生在哪位角色。
acceptanceCriteria: 通过独立静默全局技能监听原生 useCard1/respond；只对真实已提交 useCard/respond 的出牌者现有框层做240ms短反馈，独立去重/生命周期，不复用语音去重，不新增提示条/文字/伤害数。
选择/取消/弃牌/技能成本/回放/animate:false 不误触发；虚拟牌按有效卡牌；静音或 audio:false 不禁用视觉。
原生 damage 既有正伤害、受害者、最终属性、预防/取消/unreal/去重边界保持；火/雷可用不同短色闪，混合未知属性中性，不由杀推断命中。
减少动态立即取消闪动；销毁移除技能、hook、DOM、timer，迟到调用无效；不改变任何原生方法返回值/动作时机。
执行锁定 useCard/respond/damage 源码的回归通过，全部Node回归/JS/CSS解析/生产构建通过；父真实静音出牌、响应、受击、复杂选择、自然2v2结算验证，最终3/4/8布局、普通入口和console检查通过。
userStories.notes: Added an independent silent native useCard1/respond observer with 240 ms source-player feedback, separate from audio deduplication. Parent muted native 2v2: choosing Shan/Nanman and a Lieqiong part produced no committed pulse; manual Shan resolved without damage, manual Nanman triggered the ally's actual respond pulse (#b8d7d5, 0.24s). AI and human-seat committed uses showed #e8c991; manual Slash caused XinSunziLiufang HP 2→1 and a hit pulse on that victim (#c6533d, 0.24s). Native illustrated Lieqiong selection/cancellation remained intact. Iron Chain recast used native manual confirmation; settings preserved selection, reduced motion hid flashes while keeping the acting tab, and restoring motion did not replay old events. The same real game continued through native autoplay to a round-3 2v2 victory (04:59), saved its local record and returned to a functional lobby. Final real 3/4/8 layouts checked; fresh 1280×720 landlord and 1024×640 identity-8 screenshots have 3/8 overlay pairs, readable 53.4px acting tab and sound off. Ordinary index.html retained the native mode chooser with zero SGS styles/overlays. All browser warning/error logs empty. Exact pinned use/respond regressions failed before implementation; 10 focused and 258 full Node22 tests pass, including final fire/thunder/mixed damage and disposal boundaries. JS syntax, PostCSS, production build, source/dist equality and diff checks pass; independent review clear. Fire/thunder color branches are source-executed tests; no claim of browser capture for those two colors.
